verdict.rationale: Graphite Agent lets teams write their conventions down as explicit custom rules and comment exclusions, which it then applies to every future PR review, and it is described as codebase-aware. This is manually configured guidance, not a persistent memory that learns from past review decisions. Missing for 10: automatic learning or memory of past review decisions and feedback, evidence that conventions are inferred rather than hand-written, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
